Decreased TNF-alpha (-0.82 vs +2.27 pg/mL at Day 169)
Decreased rheumatoid factor (-49.8 vs -18.6 IU/mL at Day 169)
Decreased E-selectin (-13.8 vs -6.52 ng/mL at Day 169)
Decreased SICAM-1 (-65.0 vs -42.0 ng/mL at Day 169)
Decreased MMP3 (-37.2 vs -8.03 ng/mL at Day 169)
subgroup_findings: RF positive patients: 312 abatacept vs 130 placebo at baseline
RF negative patients: 42 abatacept vs 18 placebo at baseline
safety_signals: Infections/infestations: 50 abatacept vs 12 placebo in DB period
Neoplasms: 14 abatacept vs 9 placebo in DB period
Autoimmune disorders: 13 abatacept vs 2 placebo in DB period
Acute infusional AEs: 38 abatacept vs 9 placebo in DB period

dose_info.dose: weight-titered: 500 mg (<60 kg), 750 mg (60-100 kg), 1 gram (>100 kg)
dose_info.schedule: IV on Day 1, Day 15, Day 29, then every 28 days

modulation_entries.hypothesis: methotrexate provides baseline immune suppression that enhances abatacept's T-cell costimulation blockade
modulation_entries.citation: combination of abatacept plus methotrexate showed superior efficacy compared to methotrexate alone with 28.2% difference in ACR 20 response
